note: Media Power BI provides a media source plugin media_power_bi (label 'Media Power BI') whose source field is string_long, plus a matching display formatter media_power_bi (settings width default 100%, height default 900px) and a validation constraint media_power_bi that requires the URL host to be app.powerbi.com / app.powerbigov.us / app.high.powerbigov.us / app.mil.powerbigov.us. Depends on core media + media_library. No config route, no permissions, no schema. The persistent state is a media type whose source is media_power_bi (config media.type.<id> -> source, source_configuration.source_field). Medium reads back the source plugin / source field of a known media type; hard creates a media type using the media_power_bi source, verified against the live media type config. All fixtures are namespaced: media type ids mpb_*, source fields field_mpb_* (string_long on the media entity type).

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module media_power_bi lets you embed Microsoft Power BI reports as Media. What is the media source plugin id it provides and what field type is its source field?
evals.expected_output: It provides the media source plugin media_power_bi ('Media Power BI') whose source field is a string_long (long text) holding the Power BI embed URL.

evals.prompt: Which URLs does media_power_bi accept as valid Power BI embeds? Name at least one allowed host and what happens if the URL host is not one of them.
evals.expected_output: Its validation constraint accepts only hosts app.powerbi.com, app.powerbigov.us, app.high.powerbigov.us, and app.mil.powerbigov.us (checked by MediaPowerBiHelper::isValidPowerBiUrl()). Any other host (or an empty value) fails validation with a message telling the editor to re-copy from Power BI's share/embed dialog.

evals.prompt: How do I set up media_power_bi so editors can add Power BI embeds, and is there an admin settings page to configure first?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route or settings page. You create a Media type and choose 'Media Power BI' as its media source (which creates the string_long source field); then editors add embeds via the Media Library 'Embed Code' textarea or a media reference field. It requires core media and media_library.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a media type with the machine id mpb_powerbi. Inspect the live media type configuration and tell me which media source plugin it uses.
evals.expected_output: The media type mpb_powerbi uses the media source plugin media_power_bi (media.type.mpb_powerbi -> source: media_power_bi).

evals.prompt: This site has a Media Power BI media type with machine id mpb_gov. Inspect it on the running site and state the machine name of its configured source field and that field's field type.
evals.expected_output: media.type.mpb_gov has source_configuration.source_field = field_mpb_gov, and field_mpb_gov is a string_long field on the media entity type.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new media type with the machine id mpb_report that uses the Media Power BI media source so editors can embed Power BI reports. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create media type mpb_report with source = media_power_bi (and a string_long source field, e.g. field_mpb_report, referenced by source_configuration.source_field). Verify requires media.type.mpb_report to exist with source media_power_bi.

evals.prompt: Create a fully wired Media Power BI media type on this site with machine id mpb_dash: it must use the media_power_bi source and have a string_long source field configured as its source field. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create media type mpb_dash with source media_power_bi and a string_long source field (e.g. field_mpb_dash) wired via source_configuration.source_field. Verify requires source == media_power_bi and the source field to be string_long.
